rows.contract: Drain unread physical body and block padding; process local PAX and long-name metadata; global PAX returned as an entry without persisting global state. rows.contract: Typed abstract tree capability with ordered children, lstat metadata, read-link, open/read/close. Skip root dot; recurse lexically; permit regular/directory/symlink, reject other kinds; close opened sources even on copy failure and preserve close outcome.
